name: navigation a command lost leaves the output incomplete only where the page it led to is still in the output: a split, a convert of selected pages and a page deletion leave out what the caller asked, a merge and a create lose what they hold; a bookmark that opened its page through a named destination still opens it, one that only lost its place in its page is said apart, and an edit's warning names the bookmarks by their address

contains.message: 0 bookmark(s), 0 link(s) and 1 named destination(s) no longer lead to their page, although their part holds it: the parts carry no named destinations, so what led there through one leads nowhere.
contains.hint: No operation re-creates links or named destinations: tell the user which no longer lead to their page.

contains.message: 0 bookmark(s), 2 link(s) and 0 named destination(s) lead to a page of another part, so they lead nowhere in their own.
contains.hint: The pages they led to are in other parts, as the split asked; tell the user they lead nowhere in the parts.

contains.message: 2 bookmark(s) of the parts open their page as a whole, not at the place in it they opened in the input.
contains.hint: They still open their page. No operation sets the place in a page a bookmark opens at: tell the user if that place matters.

contains.message: 2 bookmark(s), 2 link(s) and 1 named destination(s) lead to pages that --pages did not select.
contains.hint: Select every page the navigation needs, or delete those bookmarks and links in a 'pdf edit' batch before converting.

contains.message: 0 bookmark(s), 1 link(s) and 1 named destination(s) no longer lead to their page, although the merged document holds it: it carries no named destinations, so what led there through one leads nowhere.
contains.hint: No operation re-creates links or named destinations: tell the user which no longer lead to their page.

contains.message: 2 bookmark(s) of the merged document open their page as a whole, not at the place in it they opened in the input.
contains.hint: They still open their page. No operation sets the place in a page a bookmark opens at: tell the user if that place matters.

contains.message: 1 bookmark(s), 1 link(s) and 1 named destination(s) lead to pages the edit deleted.
contains.hint: The pages they led to were deleted as the batch asked. Bookmarks you no longer need can be removed with {"op":"delete_bookmarks","bookmarks":["2"]}. No operation deletes links or named destinations: tell the user they lead nowhere.

contains.message: 0 bookmark(s), 2 link(s) and 0 named destination(s) lead nowhere: the importer gives a link to an element id or to a local file no target.
contains.hint: Mark each place a link leads to with , which the importer links to, give a link to another document its https address, and create the PDF again.
